maria (Docs): Quick heads-up — PR #8457 fixes Rust SDK examples, updates the migration guide, and tweaks sidebar ordering. Need one more tech review + approval window this week before Friday freeze. Who can eyeball?

liam (DevEx): @maria I can do a pass today. Noticed Netlify preview for the PR is showing a CSS mismatch vs Vercel. I suspect the preview CDN hash step is flaky.

sam (Eng): @liam I can repro locally. Netlify preview failed on artifact upload earlier — CI shows an "artifact-shard-upload timeout". @ci-bot link: https://ci.example/reports/8457

ci-bot: check failed — link-checker returned exit code 2 on preview. Logs: `Error: relative link ./../getting-started not found` (retrying)

anya (Docs): If link-checker is flaky, can we temporarily skip it for this PR and re-run Netlify deploy? what's the merge policy for exceptions?

maria (Docs): Policy: need one engineering review + docs lead approval. For merge timing we prefer to merge during the midnight merge window (00:30-02:00 PT) to avoid heavy traffic. Friday freeze is 2026-03-27 23:59 PT.

liam (DevEx): For local preview (fastest), run:

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
# or to mirror preview builds:
MAKEDOCS_PREVIEW=1 ./scripts/build_preview.sh
```

And to reproduce CI artifact upload locally:

```
npm run build:assets && ./scripts/upload_artifacts.sh --dry-run
```

sam (Eng): I'll run the Netlify rebuild after @liam's review. If link-check keeps flaking, let's bypass only on this PR and add a follow-up issue to harden the checker.

eva (QA): I'll sanity-check the rendered Rust snippets and examples once we have the preview URL.

maria (Docs): Thanks. @liam please ping thread when review done. If all green, target merge slot 2026-03-26 01:00 PT.

liam (DevEx): Reviewing now, will reply with inline comments in ~45m :mag_right: 

ci-bot: build queued (netlify-preview): https://netlify.example/preview/8457 (status: failed -> retrying)

sam (Eng): FYI I ran `./scripts/upload_artifacts.sh --chunk-size=4` and it succeeded locally; pushed artifact fix to branch `docs/8457-artifact-chunk-fix`.

maria (Docs): Awesome — new preview link posted? @ci-bot

ci-bot: new preview ready: https://netlify.example/preview/8457-2 (status: success) :rocket: 

anya (Docs): Looks good to me, approved. Left a tiny nit about heading level.

eva (QA): snippets render correctly, copy-pasted the Rust sample into a tiny project and it compiles.

maria (Docs): Great — @sam please merge during the midnight window if no regressions. Tag release note: "docs: rust sdk snippets, migration guide updates (PR #8457)". :white_check_mark:
